propositions: The environment variable scanner recognizes only os.environ.get, os.environ[...] subscript, and os.getenv forms, causing environment reads via os.environ.pop or os.environ.setdefault to be silently omitted from docs/env-vars.md with no error signal.

Changing os.environ.get(key) to os.environ.pop(key, default) silently drops the key from the generated registry and documentation despite the variable still being read, violating the stated invariant that new reads cannot ship undocumented.

The CI drift gate test_generators_not_stale_and_include_new_keys only runs in the full test suite, not in make lint, creating asymmetric feedback where local builds pass but CI fails on stale documentation.

The scanner must classify all os.environ attribute accesses (get, pop, setdefault, __getitem__, copy, items, keys, values, etc.) and raise an exception on unrecognized forms rather than silently skipping them, making undocumented reads a build failure.
